scientific_hypothesis: Species pairs with more similar LGM climatic refugial opportunity will show more spatially concordant post-IBD mitochondrial genetic discontinuity, beyond present climatic similarity and geographic sampling opportunity.

sdm.occurrence_source: fresh external GBIF occurrences; do not use genetic differentiation to select or filter occurrences
sdm.model_family: regularized presence-background climatic SDM with fixed linear and quadratic feature basis

pairwise_predictors.primary: R_LGM = Schoener D between normalized 21 ka climatic-suitability surfaces on the common Palearctic grid
pairwise_predictors.mandatory_current_nuisance: R_current = Schoener D between normalized 0 BP suitability surfaces
pairwise_predictors.optional_sensitivity: Stable-refugial opportunity based on cellwise min(S_LGM,S_current); sensitivity only and cannot replace R_LGM.

ttf_q_order: quantify SDM/relation repeatability if occurrence bootstrap reconstruction is feasible
remove exact source and target identity
remove declared current-climate, geography, lineage and sampling controls
qualify null behavior of the intended dyadic estimator
report the effect-size by nuisance-heterogeneity evaluable envelope
only then decide whether the prespecified genetic subpanel response may be opened
claim_boundary: Passing TTF-Q would show only that the LGM relation is independently informative and inferentially evaluable on this subpanel geometry. It would not show that shared refugia cause concordant genetic breaks until the separately frozen genetic response is opened.
